name: Canvas Design
tagline: Create beautiful visual art and designs — posters, graphics, and visual compositions with design philosophy.
description: Complete workflow for creating original visual art and designs in PNG and PDF formats. Two-step process: Design Philosophy Creation (develop an aesthetic movement/visual philosophy) and Canvas Expression (create museum-quality visual designs). Emphasizes visual communication over text, expert craftsmanship, spatial composition, color theory, and artistic interpretation. Includes guidance on design principles, typography integration, multi-page compositions, and achieving professional-grade output. Creates original designs without copying existing artists' work.
author: anthropics
